sequence_notes.rule: Veo's camera stays locked; Premiere does any push, eased.
sequence_notes.why: Camera moves make Omni redraw the scene.

sequence_notes.rule: The title cards (1919, 2026), the plaque words and "Same bench." are made in the edit, never by Flow.
sequence_notes.why: Jack wants the dates exact; Flow garbles text.

sequence_notes.rule: No Flow speech. "Forget it." is an AI Studio voice (being cast now); if his lips move, lip-sync-dub matches them.
The film-stock flicker, grain and scratches can be added in the edit as well, so A and B share exactly the same damage.
sequence_notes.why: The joke is that nothing changed.

sequence_notes.rule: Motion prompts are written clean-room after you pick: a sealed writer gets the option's idea and the still, nothing from the repo.

frames.job: 1919: he dismisses a man who gave a leg for him, without looking at him.

options.label: He never moves his lips
options.idea: He stays smiling at us, mouth closed; one lazy flick of the gloved hand towards the soldier. The soldier slowly gets up on his crutch and limps out of the light. The voice says "Forget it." over a face that does not move: the creepiest version.

lanes.does: Locked camera; hand flick; the soldier rises and leaves; the lamp flame flickers.
A very slow push in on him as the soldier leaves.

options.cut: Hold on him alone for a beat after the soldier is gone, then the 2026 card.
options.risk: The soldier walking on a crutch with one leg is hard for Omni; he may grow a second leg.

options.label: He says it (lip-synced)
options.idea: His mouth forms "Forget it." with the same courteous smile; the soldier lowers his head and stays seated, fading as the lamp dims on his side.

lanes.does: Locked camera; his mouth moves for two words; the lamp dims on the soldier's side.
Fit the AI Studio voice to his mouth.

options.risk: Lip sync on a face with no visible eyes is easy to judge; low risk.

options.label: The flame gutters
options.idea: Barely anything moves: the gas flame gutters, the film flickers, his smile widens a fraction. The soldier is simply gone in the next flicker of the projector. A ghost-story cut instead of an exit.

lanes.does: Locked camera; flame gutters; the smile widens.
A 2-frame flash cut to a plate with the soldier gone (made from the same still).

options.risk: Needs an empty-bench plate (a quick still edit).

frames.job: 2026: the same man, the same flick, a nurse this time. It must feel like a rerun.

options.label: Exact rerun of A
options.idea: Whatever he does in A, he does here exactly: the same flick, the same timing. The nurse gets up and walks off towards the hospital doors behind. The ambulance's light turns slowly in the background.

lanes.does: Locked camera; hand flick; the nurse leaves; ambulance beacon turns.
The same push as A, frame for frame.

options.cut: Hold on him alone, then C.

options.label: She doesn't even get up
options.idea: The nurse stays slumped, too tired to leave; only her head drops. He flicks his hand anyway. The hospital doors open and close behind on their own.

lanes.does: Locked camera; her head drops; his flick; the doors slide.

frames.job: The button: he knows we're watching, and he is not worried.

options.label: Hat tip to us
options.idea: He slowly lifts the hat a few inches towards the lens and sets it back, the smile widening by a hair. The projector flicker gets heavier, and the frame burns out to white on a hiss (Premiere/ffmpeg) under the caption "Same bench.".

lanes.does: Locked camera; the hat lift and return.

options.label: Turns to look at the next one
options.idea: Mid hat-tip, his head turns slowly to the empty seat beside him, as if someone new has just sat down off screen. Iris closes to black.

lanes.does: Locked camera; the hat lift, the slow head turn.

options.risk: Head turns can redraw the face.
